title: Rava son of Rabbah bar Rav Huna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Eruvin 55b:5-6](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.55b.5-6), disagreeing there with his father. In [Chullin 76a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.76a.12), Hyman reports three differing teachings in the name of Rav Assi, from Rabbah, Rabbah bar Rav Huna, and Rava son of Rabbah bar Huna. In [Sotah 49a:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.49a.10) it reads Abba son of Rabbah bar Rav Huna.
In [Chullin 124b:17](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.124b.17): “Rava his son said to Rabbah bar Rav Huna.”[^2]

notes.text: In the consulted text of [Chullin 76a:12](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.76a.12), the first two speakers cite Rav Ashi. The third cites Rav Assi. The translation preserves Hyman’s reading.

In Eruvin, Rava disagrees with his father about a bow-shaped town, and Abaye supports Rava. Sotah names Abba in the story of the fragrant date. Chullin has Rava ask his father about Rav Avya the Elder. The names are kept as they stand in each passage.
